The adult visitor rests beside the fountain before continuing along the permitted route. The route separates the water feature from the food counter and the places providing activities. Before buying refreshments, the visitor checks the current opening information. The names describe each facility’s purpose; they do not promise that every facility is open or that every route is accessible at every moment. The visitor follows the actual venue information rather than an invented map in an illustration.
